_comment: Reference list of MCP servers to wire after `claude login`. sre-helpers step 21 does NOT auto-run these — MCPs typically need per-user credentials, so wiring is a manual `claude mcp add` step. Copy the command for each server you want, fill in the secret, and run it as the target user.

filesystem.notes: Grants Claude read/write access to the user's home directory. Narrow the path if you want stricter scope (e.g. "$HOME/projects").

github.add_command: claude mcp add github --env GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN=<PAT> -- npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-github
github.notes: Create a fine-grained PAT with repo + read:org scopes. Rotate it if it ever leaves the machine.

clickup.add_command: claude mcp add clickup --env CLICKUP_API_KEY=<key> --env CLICKUP_TEAM_ID=<id> -- npx -y @hauptsache.net/clickup-mcp
clickup.notes: API key from ClickUp Settings -> Apps -> API Token. Team ID is the numeric workspace ID (visible in the URL).

microsoft365.add_command: claude mcp add microsoft365 --env MS365_MCP_CLIENT_ID=<client-id> -- npx -y @softeria/ms-365-mcp-server
microsoft365.notes: Requires an Azure app registration. First run triggers device-code OAuth in the browser.
